subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should repeated failed exec calls with the same stable failure fingerprint ignore volatile output and trip critical/global blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it deliberately changes when agent execution is stopped for repeated failed exec calls, so maintainer acceptance of the availability tradeoff is required before merge.

options.title: Accept stricter failed-exec blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs update and exact-head validation if maintainers agree repeated stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions.

options.title: Defer for broader loop policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want session-global or fuzzy no-progress semantics settled before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter failed-exec blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs update and exact-head validation if maintainers agree repeated stable failed exec outcomes should stop runaway sessions.
